categories.alpha: Rules that generate or improve trade selection (quality signal)
categories.protection: Rules that prevent losses (risk management, stop safety)
categories.execution: Rules that control entry timing and fill quality
categories.portfolio: Rules that manage position-level or portfolio-level concentration

actions.BLOCK: Hard block — candidate rejected, cannot trade
actions.PENALIZE: Score penalty — reduces NCS or allocation score
actions.BONUS: Score bonus — increases BQS or allocation score
actions.FLAG: Advisory — flagged for manual review, not blocking
actions.ADJUST: Dynamic threshold adjustment based on conditions
actions.SIZE: Affects position size or risk allocation

rules.name: Price > MA200
rules.description: Basic trend filter: only trade stocks in uptrend above 200-day moving average
rules.notes: Hard gate in scan, but ADX/trend is also scored in BQS. The filter is pass/fail; BQS granulates the signal.

rules.name: ADX ≥ 20
rules.description: Trend strength filter: only trade stocks with measurable trend
rules.notes: Binary gate at 20. BQS-TREND scores ADX 15–35 continuously. FWS-MARGINAL penalizes ADX < 30. Weekly ADX also scores trend. Triple overlap on the same signal.

rules.name: +DI > −DI
rules.description: Direction filter: only trade stocks where buyers dominate
rules.notes: Binary gate. BQS-DIRECTION granulates the same DI spread into 0–10 pts.

rules.name: ATR% < cap
rules.description: Volatility cap: reject excessively volatile stocks
rules.notes: Hard cap at 8%. BQS-VOLATILITY also penalizes ATR% > 4%. FWS-VOL-SHOCK penalizes spikes. Triple layer on ATR.

rules.name: Data Quality
rules.description: Reject tickers with missing or invalid data
rules.notes: Unique — essential safety gate, no overlap.

rules.name: Efficiency ≥ 30
rules.description: Soft filter: demote READY → WATCH if trend efficiency is low
rules.notes: Only soft filter in stage 2. No BQS/FWS equivalent for efficiency — unique signal.

rules.name: Hurst Exponent Check
rules.description: Validate trend persistence: H < 0.5 means mean-reverting (trend may be noise)
rules.notes: Scan flags it, BQS also gives 0–8 pts bonus for Hurst. Dual use of same signal but with different effects (flag vs score).

rules.name: ATR Spike Detection
rules.description: Detect abnormal volatility: ATR ≥ 1.3× median of last 14 ATR values
rules.notes: Overlaps with FWS vol_shock (atrSpiking flag → +20 FWS) AND ATR% cap. A stock spiking gets hit 3 times: ATR% cap, ATR spike demotion, and FWS penalty.

rules.name: Status Classification
rules.description: Classify by distance to entry trigger: ≤2% READY, ≤3% WATCH, >3% FAR
rules.notes: Binary classification. BQS-PROXIMITY gives continuous 0–15 pts for the same distance metric.

rules.name: Earnings Calendar Block
rules.description: Block entry near earnings: ≤2d AUTO_NO, 3–5d DEMOTE_WATCH
rules.notes: Triple layer: scan blocks, NCS penalizes (0–20 pts), allocation score penalizes (0–10 pts). Same signal penalized 3 times.

rules.name: Anti-Chase Gap Guard
rules.description: Block entry if price gapped too far above trigger. Day-aware thresholds.
rules.notes: Anti-chase blocks on gap-up. FWS-EXTENSION also penalizes chasing 20d/55d highs. Partial overlap on 'chasing extended price'.

rules.name: Volatility Extension Check
rules.description: Force WAIT_PULLBACK if price extends > 0.8 ATR above trigger
rules.notes: Overlap with anti-chase guard (both check price extension above trigger) and FWS extension risk (chasing). Triple layer.

rules.name: Failed Breakout Cooldown
rules.description: Block re-entry for 5 days after failed breakout
rules.notes: Partial overlap with whipsaw guard (both block re-entry after stop-out). Whipsaw = 2+ stops in 30d → 60d block. Failed breakout is shorter/different trigger.

rules.name: Adaptive ATR Buffer
rules.description: Scale entry trigger by ATR% and vol regime. Tighter on high-vol, looser on low-vol.
rules.threshold: ATR% 2% → 20% buffer; ATR% 6% → 5% buffer; × volRegime multiplier
rules.notes: Unique — adjusts entry trigger, no other rule does this.

rules.name: Pullback Continuation Entry
rules.description: Mode B re-entry: if WAIT_PULLBACK and price dips to anchor zone, recalculate entry/stop
rules.threshold: Anchor ± 0.25 ATR; close > zoneHigh → new entry
rules.notes: Unique — recovery mechanism after SCAN-12 demotion.

rules.name: Slippage Buffer Adjustment
rules.description: Tighten anti-chase ATR threshold if historical slippage > 0.15% consistently
rules.threshold: avg slippage > 0.15% + POSITIVE direction → tighten; floor 0.5 ATR
rules.notes: Modifies SCAN-11 thresholds dynamically. Intentional coupling, not overlap.

rules.name: BQS: Trend Strength
rules.description: ADX 15–35 mapped to 0–25 pts. Higher ADX = stronger trend signal.
rules.notes: Overlaps with SCAN-02 (hard gate at ADX 20) and FWS-MARGINAL (penalty for ADX < 30). ADX is used 3 times.

rules.name: BQS: Direction Dominance
rules.description: +DI − −DI spread mapped to 0–10 pts
rules.notes: Continuous version of the binary SCAN-03 gate.

rules.name: BQS: Volatility Health
rules.description: ATR% sweet spot: 1–4% = max, tapers above/below. 0–15 pts.
rules.notes: Already penalizing extreme ATR% via scan cap. BQS also rewards ideal ATR%. FWS also penalizes spikes.

rules.name: BQS: Proximity to Breakout
rules.description: Distance to 20/55d high: closer = more points. 0–15 pts.
rules.notes: Continuous version of the READY/WATCH/FAR classification.

rules.name: BQS: Dual Regime Score
rules.description: Market environment: BEARISH −10, SIDEWAYS 0, BULLISH +10 to +20
rules.notes: BQS gives bonus for bullish regime. FWS penalizes unstable regime. Both measure market environment but different dimensions (direction vs stability).

rules.name: BQS: Relative Strength
rules.description: RS vs benchmark: 0–15 pts. Higher relative strength = better.
rules.notes: Unique signal — no other rule uses RS.

rules.name: BQS: Volume Ratio Bonus
rules.description: Volume ratio > 1.2 gets 0–5 pts bonus
rules.notes: BQS rewards high volume. FWS penalizes LOW volume. Same metric, different directions — intended coverage, not overlap.

rules.name: BQS: Weekly ADX Bonus
rules.description: Weekly timeframe trend confirmation: ≥30 = +10, ≥25 = +5, <20 = −5
rules.notes: Weekly ADX adds to daily ADX check. Both measure trend strength at different timeframes. Intentional multi-timeframe confirmation.

rules.name: BQS: Breakout Integrity Score
rules.description: Candle quality at breakout: body ratio + volume + close position. 0–15 pts.
rules.notes: Unique signal — per-candle quality.

rules.name: BQS: Hurst Persistence Bonus
rules.notes: Same Hurst value used by scan (flag if < 0.5) and BQS (bonus if > 0.5). Intentional layering.

rules.name: FWS: Volume Risk
rules.description: Low volume penalty: volRatio < 1.2 starts penalizing. Max 30 pts.
rules.notes: Inverse of BQS vol bonus. BQS rewards high vol, FWS penalizes low vol. Complementary — not truly redundant.

rules.name: FWS: Extension/Chasing Risk
rules.description: Extended above recent highs: both 20d+55d → 25 pts, either → 15 pts
rules.notes: Overlap with anti-chase guard and extension check. All three detect 'price has run too far'. Different mechanisms but same underlying condition.

rules.name: FWS: Marginal Trend Risk
rules.description: Weak ADX penalty: ADX < 20 → 10 pts, 20–25 → 7, 25–30 → 3, ≥30 → 0
rules.notes: Same ADX signal as SCAN-02 (hard gate at 20) and BQS-TREND (bonus). FWS adds penalty for ADX even in 20–30 zone which already passed the gate.

rules.name: FWS: Vol Shock Risk
rules.description: ATR spiking → 20 pts, ATR collapsing → 10 pts
rules.notes: Same atrSpiking flag used by scan-engine ATR spike detection. Double penalty: scan demotes/blocks AND FWS penalizes.

rules.name: FWS: Regime Instability Risk
rules.description: Unstable regime → 10 pts penalty
rules.notes: BQS gives regime direction bonus/penalty. FWS penalizes instability. Different dimensions of regime — intended coverage.

rules.name: NCS: Earnings Penalty
rules.description: NCS penalty for upcoming earnings: ≤1d → 20, ≤3d → 15, ≤5d → 10
rules.notes: Triple layer with scan block (SCAN-10) and allocation penalty (ALLOC-EARNINGS). Same condition, 3 separate penalties.

rules.name: NCS: Cluster Penalty
rules.description: Cluster concentration penalty: ramps from 0 at 80% to 20 at 100% and beyond
rules.notes: Triple layer: NCS penalizes, risk gate blocks, allocation score penalizes. Same cluster exposure signal.

rules.name: NCS: Super-Cluster Penalty
rules.description: Super-cluster concentration penalty: ramps from 80% to beyond cap
rules.notes: Partially overlaps cluster gate — super-cluster aggregates multiple clusters.

rules.name: Risk Gate: Total Open Risk
rules.description: Total portfolio risk cannot exceed profile max (10% for SMALL_ACCOUNT)
rules.notes: Unique — aggregate risk budget. No other rule caps total risk.

rules.name: Risk Gate: Max Positions
rules.description: Max 4 positions for SMALL_ACCOUNT (excludes HEDGE)
rules.notes: Module 10 (breadth safety) also caps at 4 positions when breadth < 40%. Overlap when breadth is low.

rules.name: Risk Gate: Sleeve Limit
rules.description: Sleeve exposure cannot exceed cap (CORE 80%, HIGH_RISK 40%)
rules.notes: Gate blocks at cap. Allocation score gives bonus for underweight sleeves. Different directions but same data.

rules.name: Risk Gate: Cluster Concentration
rules.description: Cluster exposure cannot exceed cap (25% for SMALL_ACCOUNT)
rules.notes: Triple layer: risk gate blocks, NCS penalizes, allocation score penalizes. Same cluster concentration signal.

rules.name: Risk Gate: Sector Concentration
rules.description: Sector exposure cannot exceed cap (30% for SMALL_ACCOUNT)
rules.notes: Dual layer: gate blocks, allocation penalizes. Same sector data.

rules.name: Risk Gate: Position Size Cap
rules.description: Single position cannot exceed profile-aware % of portfolio
rules.notes: Unique — per-position size limit.

rules.name: Allocation: Quality Component
rules.description: NCS × 0.40 → 0–40 pts. Uses NCS as input.
rules.notes: Wraps NCS — not a separate calculation, just a scaling.

rules.name: Allocation: Expectancy Component
rules.description: Historical EV for this sleeve/ATR/regime combination. −15 to +15 pts.
rules.notes: Unique — only rule using historical EvRecord data.

rules.name: Allocation: Sleeve Balance Bonus
rules.description: Bonus for underweight sleeves. 0–10 pts.
rules.notes: Uses same sleeve exposure data as gate 3 but in reverse (bonus for underweight vs block for overweight).

rules.name: Allocation: Cluster Crowding Penalty
rules.description: Penalty for concentrated clusters. 0–15 pts. Kicks in at 60% of cap.
rules.notes: Triple layer. This is the softest (starts at 60% of cap). PENALTY-CLUSTER starts at 80%. GATE-04 blocks at 100%.

rules.name: Allocation: Sector Crowding Penalty
rules.description: Penalty for concentrated sectors. 0–10 pts. Kicks in at 60%.
rules.notes: Dual layer with gate 5. Allocation penalizes before gate blocks.

rules.name: Allocation: Earnings Near Penalty
rules.description: Penalty for upcoming earnings. ≤2d = 10, 3–5d = 5, >5d = 0.
rules.notes: Triple layer with scan block and NCS penalty. Same signal, 3 penalties.

rules.name: Allocation: Correlation Penalty
rules.description: Penalty per highly-correlated holding. 5 per, max 10.
rules.notes: Unique — only rule using CorrelationFlag data for ranking.

rules.name: Allocation: Capital Inefficiency Penalty
rules.description: Penalty when risk/capital ratio is too low (burning capital for small risk).
rules.notes: Unique — capital efficiency metric.

rules.name: Stop Ladder: INITIAL
rules.description: Initial stop = entry - initialRisk (ATR × 1.5 based)
rules.notes: Unique — foundational stop placement.

rules.name: Stop Ladder: BREAKEVEN
rules.description: Move stop to breakeven once trade reaches 1.5R
rules.notes: Unique.

rules.name: Stop Ladder: LOCK_08R
rules.description: Lock 0.5R profit once trade reaches 2.5R
rules.notes: Unique.

rules.name: Stop Ladder: LOCK_1R_TRAIL
rules.description: Lock 1R + trailing ATR once trade reaches 3.0R
rules.notes: Unique.

rules.name: Stop Monotonic Rule
rules.description: Stops can NEVER decrease. Any attempt to lower a stop throws an error.
rules.notes: Sacred rule. Never modify.

rules.name: Module 10: Breadth Safety
rules.description: Cap positions to 4 when market breadth < 40%
rules.notes: Overlaps with Gate 2 when SMALL_ACCOUNT already has max 4. Breadth safety is redundant for SMALL_ACCOUNT.

rules.name: Module 11: Whipsaw Kill Switch
rules.description: Block re-entry after 2+ stop-outs in 30 days → 60-day cooldown
rules.notes: Partial overlap with failed breakout cooldown (5-day block). Different triggers, same intent.

rules.name: Module 3: Laggard Detection
rules.description: Flag underperforming positions: TRIM_LAGGARD (10d, -2%) or DEAD_MONEY (30d, <0.5R)
rules.notes: Unique — post-entry performance monitoring.

rules.name: Module 5/14: Climax Detector
rules.description: Flag climacteric moves: price 18%+ above MA20 AND volume 3× average
rules.notes: Unique — extreme extension detection for exit timing.

rules.name: Module 7: Heatmap Swap
rules.description: Suggest swapping weak position (<0.5R, negative) for strong candidate (score ≥50)
rules.notes: Unique — capital reallocation advisory.

rules.name: Correlation Matrix
rules.description: Flag highly correlated position pairs (Pearson r > 0.75)
rules.threshold: r > 0.75 on 90-day daily returns (min 60 overlap days)
rules.notes: Advisory flag. Allocation score also penalizes correlated adds. Intentional coupling.

rules.name: Breakout Probability Score
rules.description: 7-factor breakout probability: consolidation, volume, RS, sector, duration, prior trend, failure history. 0–19.
rules.notes: Supplementary score — displayed in backtest, not used for blocking or allocation. Unique factors.
